articles.title: Hundreds without power across mid-Missouri
articles.description: COLUMBIA, Mo. (KMIZ) Storms overnight into Wednesday morning are causing some areas to lose power in mid-Missouri. According to the Ameren Outage map, around 458 customers are without power in Osage Beach as of 7:40 a.m. Power has been restored in areas near the Village of Four Seasons and Rocky Mount. articles.title: Truck driver from Illinois accused of crashing into Jefferson City light pole
articles.description: COLUMBIA, Mo. (KMIZ) A truck driver from Illinois is accused of causing $50,000 in damage after he allegedly crashed a semi-truck into an Ameren light pole on July 15 in Jefferson City. Philip Kahn, of Pekin, Illinois, is charged with leaving the scene of an accident. An initial court appearance is scheduled for 10:30 a.m.
